summary: Round 1's one blocking finding (F4, followed redirects) is fixed at the root: the fan-out client now returns http.ErrUseLastResponse, so a receiver's 3xx is that leg's own answer, the 502 names the real status, and no hop is taken — closing all three traces. The new test is non-vacuous (reverting the client to &http.Client{} fails all five redirect subtests) and pins production's construction path via relay.New. No new findings; the gate, which the dispatch recorded as unverified, is green here: go test, -race, vet, gofmt and arch-validate.
